premises.text: African money movement has extremely high transaction costs and multi-day settlement, with fragmented isolated mobile-money wallets blocking cross-network, cross-border, and online payments
premises.evidence_span: Transaction costs are 15 times higher here, and settlement times can last up to 20 days

premises.text: WeCashUp is a universal payment platform with a single API for merchants to accept cash and mobile money (and in 2.0 also cards, bank wallets, and crypto) across currencies
premises.evidence_span: universal mobile money payment platform that enables online merchants to accept all cash and mobile money wallet online through a single API

premises.text: Features include high conversion, blockchain-ledger security, ease for the unbanked, split payments inviting others, and merchant tools to accept/split/disburse/hold/top-up across many countries
premises.evidence_span: best conversion rate, the highest security system using our blockchain ledger, and ease of transaction processing for the unbanked

premises.text: A patented blockchain tunneling interoperability network interconnects payment channels for cross-network, cross-border, and online payments
premises.evidence_span: first blockchain tunneling network which is a global interoperability network

premises.text: Monetization combines a monthly fee and a transaction fee
premises.evidence_span: charge a monthly fee and a transaction fee

value.text: Move money fast enough across Africa that life-critical payments (like hospital bills) can be completed in time
value.evidence_span: Moving money fast here in Africa is very, very difficult

secondary_value.text: Reach the next billion through merchants, financial institutions, and mobile-money operators

causal_links.evidence_span: charge a monthly fee and a transaction fee

notes: Personal hospital story treated as illustrating the payment-speed problem, not a separate premise. Feature list largely folded into platform cascade; patents attached to tunneling network. Merchant counts/growth excluded as traction. Anti-template: problem, platform, and pricing separately revisable.
